location: Sidewalk in front of a brewery with a hand-lettered 'ARTISINAL BREWERY' sign, city skyline sketched behind
action: Three bearded hipster bros clink craft beers outside the brewery and solemnly vow to meet in front of it every 20 years no matter what.
visual_prompt: Three men in their early 30s shoulder to shoulder holding craft beer glasses in front of a wall lettered 'ARTISINAL BREWERY', faint skyline behind. Left: slicked-back hair, waxed handlebar mustache and long pointed beard, grey t-shirt. Center: round face, full bushy beard, light knit sweater. Right: dark groomed full beard, swept-back dark hair, black t-shirt and chain necklace. All grinning, mid-toast. Medium three-shot, eye level, slight upward tilt of camaraderie.

dialogue.speaker: bro_2_pete
dialogue.line: TOTES! WE SHOULD, LIKE MEET IN FRONT OF THIS BREWERY EVERY 20 YEARS NO MATTER WHAT!

dialogue.speaker: bro_3
dialogue.line: I AM TOTALLY DOWN WITH THAT.

performance: Peak-friendship optimism; the pact that ages badly

location: Same spot in front of the 'ARTISINAL BREWERY' sign, 20 years later
action: Twenty years on, only two have shown. A greyer Bro 1, now in a suit, greets the bald Bro 3 and asks where Pete is; Bro 3 flatly reports that he thinks Pete died.
visual_prompt: Two middle-aged men in their 50s facing each other in front of the same wall lettered 'ARTISINAL BREWERY', faint skyline behind. Left: gaunt man in a suit and striped tie, receding slicked hair, grey-streaked waxed mustache and long pointed beard, smugly upright. Right: heavier bald man with a drooping thin mustache and long chin goatee, grey t-shirt, slumped and vacant. Medium two-shot, eye level, awkward gap between them.

dialogue.speaker: bro_1
dialogue.line: HEY BRO, YOU MADE IT! I AGED BETTER THAN YOU. WHERE THE FUCK IS PETE?

dialogue.speaker: bro_3
dialogue.line: HE DIED I THINK. SOMEONE TOLD ME THAT.

performance: Bleak deadpan reunion; friendship curdled into indifference

location: Same spot 20 more years on, the sign now reading 'CHIPOTLE'
action: Forty years after the pact, one shrunken old man stands alone where the brewery used to be — it is now a Chipotle. He concludes the others died on him and that the whole idea was bad. End.
visual_prompt: A single frail elderly man in his 70s, bald with wisps of white hair at the temples and a thin white chin beard, wearing a baggy light jacket over a dark collar, standing small in the lower left of frame before a wall now lettered 'CHIPOTLE', faint skyline behind. He gazes off, hollow-cheeked and resigned. Medium-wide shot, eye level, empty space pressing in around him.

dialogue.speaker: bro_1
dialogue.line: GUESS THOSE FUCKERS DIED ON ME.  THIS WAS A SHIT IDEA ANYHOW.

performance: Gallows-humor finale; the pact outlives the friendship and the brewery
